name: Як це називається? Напад (1)
description:
You already know some smart ways to attack pieces. In this lesson, you have to use a smart attack to win a piece. We won't tell you which trick to use. It is up to you to figure it out.

After your move, a question appears, asking you what your attack is called. Tick the correct answer.



What do you have to do?

Use a smart attack to win a piece and answer the question.

texts: Two pieces on the same rank offer tactical chances!
